100% Privacy. Always free. And no ads…ever. 

We understand the value of a great user experience, so we’ve thoughtfully designed Pray Watch to be quick, easy, and convenient to use…because we use it ourselves!

== Features ==
- Prayer times automatically configured for any city in the world
- One-of-a-kind “prayer ring” timer to easily visualize remaining time for prayer
- Prayer notifications with option to snooze and remind you later
- Set your masjid iqama times to be reminded to join congregational prayers
- Set a reminder to pray duha / ishraq prayer
- Choose from over 20 calculation methods, or add custom method
- Large selection of beautiful adhans from around the world
- Wide range of reminder sounds for more discreet notifications
- Pre-adhan reminder (to catch current prayer or prepare the for next one)
- Variety of Widgets for your Home and Lock Screen
- Seamlessly connect to your Apple Watch using iCloud sync
- Dynamic Apple Watch face complications
- Simple Qibla compass with haptic feedback - on iPhone and Watch
- Hijri date displayed on main screens, widgets, and complications
- Masjid Locator finds the nearest masjid in your area
- Long-press notifications for rich content like qibla compass and timer, without opening the app
- Prayer times list includes “Midnight” and “Last Third” to help you plan for tahajjud and qiyam
- Monthly Calendar with prayer times table
- Islamic Holidays displayed in app, widgets, and watch
- Arabic and Turkish language translations
- Built-in travel mode to update notifications and calculation method while traveling - without needing to open the app
- Optimized for lower data and battery consumption using the latest iOS standards
- Optional 24-hour time format
- Optional light/dark mode to match your iOS settings
- Beautiful colour themes to personalize the app, widgets, and complications
- Accessibility support
- iPad support
